statement: SN 35.31 repeatedly distinguishes conceiving a sense-domain item, conceiving in it, conceiving from it, and conceiving it as 'mine'; this supports multiple grammatical/appropriative relations for maññati without making 'identity construction' its universal lexical definition.

evidence_refs.locator: cakkhuṁ na maññati; cakkhusmiṁ na maññati; cakkhuto na maññati; cakkhuṁ meti na maññati, repeated across the sense domains
